reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering fish, fishing tackle, forage, minerals, goat milk, a restorative elixir, and lobster bisque were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish and recipe names, tackle behavior, object gender, measurements, register, and glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

LavaEel_Description.source: It can somehow survive in pools of red-hot lava.
LavaEel_Description.translation: Reușește cumva să supraviețuiască în bălți de lavă incandescentă.

LeadBobber_Description.source: Adds weight to your "fishing bar", preventing it from bouncing along the bottom.
LeadBobber_Description.translation: Adaugă greutate „barei de pescuit”, împiedicând-o să ricoșeze când ajunge jos.

Leek_Description.source: A tasty relative of the onion.

Legend_Description.source: The king of all fish! They said he'd never be caught.
Legend_Description.translation: Regele tuturor peștilor! Se spunea că nu va fi prins niciodată.

LegendII_Description.source: The successor to the original Legend.

LemonStone_Description.source: Some claim the powdered crystal is a dwarvish delicacy.
LemonStone_Description.translation: Unii susțin că acest cristal măcinat este o delicatesă a piticilor.

LGoatMilk_Name.translation: Bidon mare de lapte de capră

LGoatMilk_Description.source: A gallon of creamy goat's milk.
LGoatMilk_Description.translation: Un galon de lapte cremos de capră.

Limestone_Description.source: A very common type of stone. It's not worth very much.
Limestone_Description.translation: Un tip de piatră foarte răspândit. Nu valorează prea mult.

Lingcod_Description.source: A fearsome predator that will eat almost anything it can cram into its mouth.
Lingcod_Description.translation: Un prădător de temut care mănâncă aproape orice îi încape în gură.

Lionfish_Description.source: An aggressive, predatory fish with venomous spines.
Lionfish_Description.translation: Un pește răpitor și agresiv, cu spini veninoși.

Lobster_Description.source: A large ocean-dwelling crustacean with a strong tail.
Lobster_Description.translation: Un crustaceu marin mare, cu o coadă puternică.
